name: Salmon Teriyaki & Broccoli
steps: Combine the light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and brown sugar in a small pan, simmer until slightly thickened. Whisk in the cornflour mixed with a little water to thicken further into a teriyaki glaze.
Pat the salmon dry, brush with olive oil, and air fry at 200°C for 8-10 minutes until just cooked.
Brush the teriyaki glaze over the salmon in the last 2 minutes of cooking.
For the rice: rinse the jasmine rice, cook with the water, oil, garlic, ginger and a pinch of salt until fluffy.
If using broccoli, air fry alongside the salmon with a touch of oil until tender-crisp.
Serve the glazed salmon over the rice with broccoli on the side.
notes: Do not add extra salt — the soy sauce is salty enough on its own.

flags.shelfLife: Salmon doesn't last the full week — plan this for days 1-3 and buy accordingly.
